title: Known-object test, TOI-6674.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-6674.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 75 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 4 light curve(s), forming 26 distinct event(s), 9 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
